effect.purpose: Read-only Effect v4 source pinned to the tag matching the installed effect beta — the authority on what v4 actually exports, plus the v3→v4 migration notes.

effected.purpose: Read-only source for @effected/github-actions, @effected/github and @effected/jsonc — the libraries this action is built on. Pin tracks the installed @effected/github-actions version.

notes.note: `.claude/design/marketplace-manager/architecture.md`'s Decision D-2 cites this repo by LINE ANCHOR: `packages/github/src/GitBranch.ts:46-69` (verified resolving at this pin — line 46 is the `@remarks` opener, line 69 ends `on the bare target head.`). It is the only line-number reference from our design docs into a vendored repo, so re-pinning `effected` can silently invalidate it. The surrounding prose quotes the TSDoc's substance, so the doc stays correct either way — only the `:46-69` would go stale and mislead. Re-check that anchor on any re-pin.

`git -C .repos/effected describe --tags` reports `@effected/app@0.7.0`, NOT the `@effected/github-actions@0.5.0` this entry is pinned to. That is not drift — it is `describe` picking the nearest reachable tag in a monorepo that tags per package, and many packages share a release commit. Check the gitlink against `repos_inspect` or `git rev-parse HEAD` (expect `768e2aa`), never `describe`, before concluding the pin moved.
